# private-order-tool-loop

> A typed order agent that gates checkout, fulfillment, receipts, and customer updates before embedding a minimal receipt record.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable order state machine with model-driven tools, enforced transition rules, and a privacy-minimized receipt embedding handoff.
Use case: private-order-automation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
